title: Verify full cook ledger and launcher test alignment
objective: Review the full-cook ledger/doc updates plus Builder's launcher test alignment for regressions, then run the focused launcher test suite and any cheap ledger validation needed.
instructions: Check whether docs/environment_ledger.json accurately reflects the Experimenter full-cook result at package metadata level.
Review tests/test_spear_launcher.py for brittle or incorrect assertions introduced by the package-version update.
Run python -m unittest tests.test_spear_launcher and python -m json.tool docs/environment_ledger.json.
constraints: Do not modify files unless a small review fix is needed and clearly within scope.
Do not perform Git commits or pushes.
expected_outputs: Findings first, with file/line references if issues are found.
definition_of_done: Focused launcher tests and ledger JSON validation pass, or issues are reported clearly.
